theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by 
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  
  let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hfin : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    have hsub : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      have h₁ := hB n
      have h₂ := hB (n + 1)
      have h₃ := hB (n + 2)
      have h₄ := hB (n + 3)
      simp only at h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ ⊢
      constructor <;>
      (try constructor) <;>
      (try constructor) <;>
      (try constructor) <;>
      (try simp_all only [and_self, f]) 
    
    have hfin_Icc : Set.Finite (Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)) := by
      apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)))
      intro x hx
      simp_all only [ge_iff_le, ne_eq, mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc, mem_setOf_eq, and_self]
      
    exact Set.Finite.subset hfin_Icc hsub
  
  have h_not_inj : ¬ Function.Injective f := by
    intro h_inj
    have h_inf : Set.Infinite (Set.range f) := Set.infinite_range_of_injective h_inj
    exact Set.not_infinite.mpr hfin h_inf
  
  have h_pigeon : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! h
    have h_inj : Function.Injective f := by
      intro i j h_eq
      by_cases h_eq' : i = j
      · exact h_eq'
      · have h_order : i < j ∨ j < i := by omega
        cases h_order with
        | inl h_order =>
          simp_all only
        | inr h_order =>
          tauto
    exact h_not_inj h_inj
  
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := h_pigeon
  have h_eqs : u i = u j ∧ u (i + 1) = u (j + 1) ∧ u (i + 2) = u (j + 2) ∧ u (i + 3) = u (j + 3) := by
    simp [f] at h_eq
    exact h_eq
  
  have h_periodic : ∀ k, u (i + k) = u (j + k) := by
    intro k
    induction' k using Nat.strong_induction_on with k ih
    match k with
    | 0 => exact h_eqs.1
    | 1 => exact h_eqs.2.1
    | 2 => exact h_eqs.2.2.1
    | 3 => exact h_eqs.2.2.2
    | k + 4 =>
      have h₁ : u (i + (k + 4)) = ((u (i + (k + 4) - 1) + u (i + (k + 4) - 2) + u (i + (k + 4) - 3) * u (i + (k + 4) - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (i + (k + 4) - 1) * u (i + (k + 4) - 2) + u (i + (k + 4) - 3) + u (i + (k + 4) - 4)) := by
        have h₁' := hu (i + (k + 4)) (by omega)
        have h₂' := h₁'.1
        norm_cast at h₂' ⊢
        exact h₂'
      have h₂ : u (j + (k + 4)) = ((u (j + (k + 4) - 1) + u (j + (k + 4) - 2) + u (j + (k + 4) - 3) * u (j + (k + 4) - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (j + (k + 4) - 1) * u (j + (k + 4) - 2) + u (j + (k + 4) - 3) + u (j + (k + 4) - 4)) := by
        have h₁' := hu (j + (k + 4)) (by omega)
        have h₂' := h₁'.1
        norm_cast at h₂' ⊢
        exact h₂'
      rw [h₁, h₂]
      rw [ih (k + 3) (by omega), ih (k + 2) (by omega), ih (k + 1) (by omega), ih k (by omega)]
      <;> simp [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
  
  use i, (j - i)
  constructor
  · omega
  · intro n hn
    have h₁ : u (i + (n - i)) = u (j + (n - i)) := h_periodic (n - i)
    have h₂ : i + (n - i) = n := by omega
    have h₃ : j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) := by omega
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    rw [h₃] at h₁
    exact h₁.symm
